It seems this bug only affects dev mode. It's not happening with `./mvnw clean package` followed by `java -jar target/jaxrs-resource-1.0-SNAPSHOT-runner.jar`.

In dev mode, I can see the entity being processed through the `PanacheJpaEntityEnhancer.collectFields()` method while debugging so it's not entirely ignored (and it must explain why it works without dev mode) but the `PanacheJpaEntityEnhancer.apply()` method is only called for entities declared in the `jaxrs-resource` reproducer project and not for entites declared in the `entity-dependency` project.

I added the missing getters/setters to my entity as a workaround for this issue and now I'm facing a new `IllegalStateException` with the following message when calling the `PanacheEntityBase.find()` method:
> This method is normally automatically overridden in subclasses: did you forget to annotate your entity with @Entity?

The entity is annotated with `@Entity`.

This also happens only in dev mode. Everything's fine if I run a packaged jar like in my previous comment. The getter/setter issue and this one have to be related.

This time, I don't see any workaround.

Hi @gwenneg, I do no know why you are getting the error but I think that I have a work around.

Taking a closer  look at your project  and was able to reproduce the problem with your current setup. But then looking closer, it looked to me like a `multimodule` project, so I went on and added a `pom.xml`  file at the root of the project: 

```
    <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
    <groupId>com.gwenneg</groupId>
    <artifactId>reproducer</artifactId>
    <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>pom</packaging>

    <properties>
        <quarkus.version>0.17.0</quarkus.version>
        <compiler-plugin.version>3.8.0</compiler-plugin.version>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <project.reporting.outputEncoding>UTF-8</project.reporting.outputEncoding>
    </properties>

    <modules>
	<module>entity-dependency</module>
	<module>jaxrs-resource</module>
    </modules>
    <dependencyManagement>
        <dependencies>
            <dependency>
                <groupId>io.quarkus</groupId>
                <artifactId>quarkus-bom</artifactId>
                <scope>import</scope>
                <type>pom</type>
                <version>${quarkus.version}</version>
            </dependency>
        </dependencies>
    </dependencyManagement>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>${compiler-plugin.version}</version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- the parameters=true option is critical so that RESTEasy works fine -->
                    <parameters>true</parameters>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <!-- This is what injects the magic Quarkus bytecode -->
                <groupId>io.quarkus</groupId>
                <artifactId>quarkus-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>${quarkus.version}</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>build</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>		
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>
```

And then I added:

```
<parent>
    <groupId>com.gwenneg</groupId>
    <artifactId>reproducer</artifactId>
    <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <relativePath>../</relativePath>
 </parent>

```
in the `pom.xml` file of the two modules. 
Then running `mvn clean compile` in `entity-dependency` and then `mvn clean compile quarkus:dev` inside `jaxrs-resource` module seems to work when hitting `curl localhost:8080/reproducer/test` endpoint. 
HTH

Hi @machi1990 and thanks for taking the time to help me.

My reproducer may look like a multi-modules Maven project with a missing parent `pom.xml`, but I actually didn't add this `pom.xml` on purpose. At first, I wanted to reproduce this issue with two separate repositories and then I got lazy and put everything in the same repository :)

I am trying to use Panache in several real projects which can't be part of a multi-modules parent project. I need this to work with a simple compile dependency relation between these projects.

It appears that we do detect that we need to modify the entity archive, because we create the modified jar, but we don't populate it:


The augmented entity is properly in `target/jaxrs-resource-1.0-SNAPSHOT-runner.jar` though.

Ah, so it's normal that these archives don't have the types we transform, I forgot that was the resolution of #2196.

Note that this is working in the `java -jar target/...-runner.jar` case.

In this case, in `quarkus:dev` I can see that the class is loaded from the unmodified archive: `/home/stephane/.m2/repository/com/gwenneg/entity-dependency/1.0-SNAPSHOT/entity-dependency-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar` rather than the augmented classes.

At this point, surely @stuartwdouglas will know why it's not using the augmented class in dev mode.
I just tested with master (2f519a49cdb6ecfa81874e9e1cb7a4d6423c3a23), this bug is still happening.
Fix confirmed from `master` with the reproducer.
